50261736.protein: Induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1
50261736.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human MCL1 (173 to 329 aa) by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Instruments, Inc.). The MCL1 protein (173–329) was dialyzed against 25 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 100 mM NaCl, 0.1 mM TCEP, and 4% DMSO. The protein was loaded into the sample cell at a concentration of 25 μM. The ligand was dissolved in the same buffer and loaded into the syringe at a concentration of 800 μM. The experiment was conducted at 25 °C with a stirring speed of 300 rpm. The ligand was injected in 20 aliquots of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. A control experiment with buffer in the syringe was performed to correct for heats of dilution.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 25 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 0.1 mM TCEP, 4% DMSO
assay_conditions.control_method: A control experiment with buffer in the syringe was performed to correct for heats of dilution
